name: get_context
description: Assembled context for one step of building a ReFormer form: operator + signature + one example + rules, anti-patterns and links, deduplicated and budgeted. For a single "which API" question choose_api is cheaper and sharper.

task.description: The task in plain words (Russian or English).

topics.description: Topic ids from reformer://catalog; inferred from the task when omitted.

name: choose_api
description: Pick the right ReFormer operator for a requirement, stated in your own words ("field B is only available when A is filled", "shipping address copies billing", "clear the field when the parent choice changes"). Answers the question the docs search cannot: which of two similar operators applies — computeFrom vs copyFrom, copyFrom vs syncFields, enableWhen vs hideWhen, resetWhen vs enableWhen, validateWhen vs enableWhen, apply vs applyEach (one sub-model vs every array row), and resetWhen vs onChange (a predicate that holds vs the bare fact that a field changed — including clearing an array, which uses onChange + .clear(), never resetValue). Returns the recommended symbol with its signature, a canonical example, why it fits, the alternatives it is commonly confused with, and any anti-pattern the docs record for that choice. Deterministic — same requirement, same answer.

requirement.description: One requirement in plain words, Russian or English. E.g. "поле B доступно только когда A заполнено", "total = price * quantity", "confirmPassword must match password".

target.description: Optional stack hint: "core" | "renderer-react" | "renderer-json". Narrows the fallback search when no rule matches.

name: get_symbol_docs
description: Full JSDoc for one public @reformer/* symbol: description, signature, params, examples, source.

package.description: Restrict to one package: core | cdk | ui-kit | renderer-react | renderer-json (full name or short). Omit for all.

name: find_recipe
description: A worked recipe for a scenario keyword ("wizard", "form-array", "copy-from", "json-schema") or the @example of a symbol. An unknown topic falls through to full-text search, so it returns candidates rather than nothing.

topic.description: Topic keyword. Matches docs/llms/ filenames (with or without NN- prefix), `## ` section headings inside those files, or a public symbol name across all @reformer/* packages.

package.description: Restrict to one package: core | cdk | ui-kit | renderer-react | renderer-json (full name or short). Omit for all.

name: search_docs
description: Full-text search over all @reformer/* docs, for when you can describe the task but cannot name it. Returns ranked sections with their reformer://docs/… URI, a matched snippet, and the relevant API names.

query.description: Words describing what you are looking for (e.g. "conditional required validation", "wizard step guard"). Matched case-insensitively against section titles and bodies; multiple words are AND-preferred but not required.

package.description: Restrict to one package: core | cdk | ui-kit | renderer-react | renderer-json (full name or short). Omit for all.

name: list_symbols
description: List public symbols, filtered by kind, package or nameContains. Output is capped — narrow the filter. To find API by TASK rather than by name, choose_api and search_docs answer instead of listing.

kind.description: Filter by declaration kind. Omit to include all kinds.

package.description: Restrict to one package: core | cdk | ui-kit | renderer-react | renderer-json (full name or short). Omit for all.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring the symbol name must contain (e.g. "validate", "FileUpload"). Strongly recommended: the unfiltered list is 800+ symbols in one response.

name: validate_form
description: Check a ReFormer form before running it. kind="code": generated TS — unknown or wrongly imported @reformer symbols, operators called outside their schema, deprecated API. kind="json-schema": the layout DSL. kind="behaviors": compute cycles. kind="bundle": a whole FormIntent + layout, cross-checked against each other. kind="layout": form-module FILE NAMES against the canonical per-target set (files[] + target) — catches schema.ts / render-behavior.ts drift, accepts the optional steps/<slug>/ wizard folders, flags former renderer.* names as warnings, and names the expected file; run it before writing them. Returns RF0xx diagnostics with line, what to do and the next call to make.

files.description: kind=layout: file names or paths of the form module (a common leading directory is stripped).

target.description: kind=layout: core | renderer-react | renderer-json; inferred from files when omitted.

schema.description: kind=json-schema: the layout schema (object or JSON string). kind=bundle: optional — the schema to check the intent against; without it, the schema the build would make.

dependencies.description: kind=behaviors: one entry per computed field — { target, reads[] }.

intent.description: kind=bundle: the FormIntent (object or JSON string) — judged as the build judges it.

name: plan_form
description: Draft <dir>/form.intent.json from a markdown form spec: fields with types and components, validation from the spec tables, wizard steps, arrays. The draft is written to disk (an existing file is never overwritten); the answer is a short summary and what to finish by hand. Then edit the intent and call form_build.

specPath.description: Markdown spec, absolute or relative to the working directory.

dir.description: Form folder for the draft, as in form_build (default "form").

target.description: Stack from the task: core | renderer-react | renderer-json (default core).

name: form_build
description: Build a form module on disk from <dir>/form.intent.json: compiles it, cross-checks it, type-checks the result and WRITES all module files itself, returning only diagnostics. You author and edit only form.intent.json with your own Write/Edit; nothing is written while errors remain. Start with {"grammar":"base"} — the intent grammar, no project or file needed; further sections on demand. Keep the requested stack in "target": on core you also write the JSX markup in index.tsx.

dir.description: Form folder, relative to the working directory (default "form"; required at a monorepo root).

grammar.description: Return the intent grammar instead of building: "base", a section (behavior, arrays, wizard, cross, async, parts, operators, nodes), several comma-separated, or "all"; "components:Card,Tabs" — parts and props of kit components.

name: report_issue
description: Record a ReFormer problem and its fix as a JSON report on disk (`<project>/.reformer/issue_reports`, override REFORMER_ISSUE_REPORTS_DIR). Not aggregated, not fed back into other tools.

error.description: The error message or problem description

solution.description: The solution or fix that resolved the issue

tags.description: Tags for categorization. Recommended: category:<type> (schema, validation, behavior, react, types, other), agent:<name> (claude, cursor), severity:<level> (critical, major, minor)
